outcome: Incidence of developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH)
cohort: 2582 newborns in Arar City, Saudi Arabia
finding: The incidence of DDH was 6.19 per 1000 live births, and DDH was significantly associated with primiparity, low birth weight, prematurity, and positive family history of DDH.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery occurred in 11 cases (68.75%), a caesarean section in 5 cases (31.25%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight associated with DDH
